title: Dome of the Rock, Jerusalem
summary: The Dome of the Rock is a shrine on the Temple Mount (Haram al-Sharif) in Jerusalem, commissioned in 691 CE by the Umayyad caliph Abd al-Malik on the site of the destroyed Second Temple. One encyclopedia says Egypt's tax revenue paid for it over seven years; scholars differ on whether it aimed to divert pilgrims from Mecca or rival the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. UNESCO lists it among the Old City's monuments.

uncertainty.note: World History Encyclopedia gives 691 CE (commissioned, article on Jerusalem) and 688-691 CE (image caption); Encyclopedia.com gives 691-2. End is the present: the building stands. A part collapsed in the 748 earthquake (Encyclopedia.com).
